label: accuracy
definition: High-risk AI systems must be designed and developed to achieve an appropriate level of accuracy throughout their lifecycle.
source_quote: High-risk AI systems shall be designed and developed in such a way that they achieve an appropriate level of accuracy

label: robustness
definition: High-risk AI systems must be designed and developed to achieve an appropriate level of robustness throughout their lifecycle.
source_quote: High-risk AI systems shall be designed and developed in such a way that they achieve an appropriate level of robustness

label: cybersecurity
definition: High-risk AI systems must be designed and developed to achieve an appropriate level of cybersecurity throughout their lifecycle.
source_quote: High-risk AI systems shall be designed and developed in such a way that they achieve an appropriate level of cybersecurity

label: resilience regarding errors, faults or inconsistencies
definition: High-risk AI systems must be as resilient as possible regarding errors, faults or inconsistencies that may occur within the system or its environment.
source_quote: High-risk AI systems shall be as resilient as possible regarding errors, faults or inconsistencies that may occur within the system or the environment in which the system operates

label: resilience against attempts by unauthorised third parties to alter use, outputs or performance
definition: High-risk AI systems must be resilient against attempts by unauthorised third parties to alter their use, outputs or performance by exploiting system vulnerabilities.
source_quote: High-risk AI systems shall be resilient against attempts by unauthorised third parties to alter their use, outputs or performance by exploiting system vulnerabilities

label: appropriate technical solutions for cybersecurity
definition: Technical solutions aiming to ensure the cybersecurity of high-risk AI systems must be appropriate to the relevant circumstances and the risks.
source_quote: The technical solutions aiming to ensure the cybersecurity of high-risk AI systems shall be appropriate to the relevant circumstances and the risks

label: measures to prevent, detect, respond to, resolve and control for attacks trying to manipulate the training data set
definition: Technical solutions addressing AI specific vulnerabilities must include measures to prevent, detect, respond to, resolve and control for attacks trying to manipulate the training data set.
source_quote: measures to prevent, detect, respond to, resolve and control for attacks trying to manipulate the training data set

label: measures to prevent, detect, respond to, resolve and control for attacks trying to manipulate pre-trained components
definition: Technical solutions addressing AI specific vulnerabilities must include measures to prevent, detect, respond to, resolve and control for attacks trying to manipulate pre-trained components used in training.
source_quote: measures to prevent, detect, respond to, resolve and control for attacks trying to manipulate the training data set (data poisoning), or pre-trained components used in training (model poisoning)

label: measures to prevent, detect, respond to, resolve and control for inputs designed to cause mistakes
definition: Technical solutions addressing AI specific vulnerabilities must include measures to prevent, detect, respond to, resolve and control for inputs designed to cause the AI model to make a mistake.
source_quote: inputs designed to cause the AI model to make a mistake (adversarial examples or model evasion)

label: measures to prevent, detect, respond to, resolve and control for confidentiality attacks
definition: Technical solutions addressing AI specific vulnerabilities must include measures to prevent, detect, respond to, resolve and control for confidentiality attacks.

label: measures to prevent, detect, respond to, resolve and control for model flaws
definition: Technical solutions addressing AI specific vulnerabilities must include measures to prevent, detect, respond to, resolve and control for model flaws.
